title: At a strip mall..
content: So I've been to the Mall World in my dreams. It is one of the most consistent dream realms I go to and I've had more lucid dreams while there than any place else. Well this morning I actually dreamed of being at an outdoor strip mall and in particular walking into a store that sold books and had racks of clothes too. The most unusual part though is that my cat was with me, which he does follow me when I walk around the house sometimes. So I'm just curious if anyone else has been to an outdoor strip mall or had their pets show up while in or around the mall world?
